articles.summary: A seasoned expert, Mike Tierney, has identified several promising parlays for Week 11 of the NFL season.
articles.content: Week 11 of the NFL season offers numerous opportunities for football fans to engage in parlay betting. A seasoned expert has identified some promising parlays involving favorites and underdogs. One of these experts is Mike Tierney, a veteran sportswriter with an impressive track record covering the NFL over several decades. He has reported from seven Super Bowls and his work periodically appears in prominent publications such as the New York Times and Los Angeles Times. Tierney's expertise extends to providing actionable advice for bettors. His NFL predictions have yielded significant returns, including a 56.3 percent success rate against the spread (ATS) over the past two seasons. In the same period, his overall record stands at 320-271-16, resulting in substantial profits for those following his recommendations. Tierney's insights are not limited to specific teams or matchups but encompass broader trends and patterns within the league. His ability to identify underperforming teams like the Titans has proven valuable for bettors seeking to capitalize on favorable odds. The Cowboys' upcoming matchup against the struggling Titans presents an attractive opportunity for a successful parlay. The Titans have been plagued by defensive issues, allowing 83 points in their last two games. This lackluster performance is particularly concerning given that they are facing a team with a renewed emphasis on defense following changes to their play calling. Dallas's adjustments to their defensive strategy may prove to be the decisive factor in determining the outcome of this game. With Tierney recommending parlays involving both favorites and underdogs, there are multiple paths for bettors to explore as the Week 11 schedule unfolds. The Jacksonville Jaguars' dominance has been nothing short of impressive over their last three weeks, outscoring opponents by an average margin of 25 points. A key factor in their success is the time they've had to fine-tune new additions Jordan Davis and Jessie Bates, who were held back from playing last Sunday. As a result, both players are now raring to go, having had extra practice and study time under their belts. Trevor Lawrence has been making a strong case for himself as one of the league's top MVP contenders. Meanwhile, the Giants' 5-3-1 start is somewhat deceiving, considering that many of their wins have come against teams with a combined record of 13-34. Furthermore, two of their losses were to teams with sub-.500 records. In Monday night's game, we're backing a team led by a quarterback who's been impressing the likes of Trevor Lawrence and other top contenders. Joe Burrow has been on fire, throwing 20 touchdown passes in his last five games while maintaining an impressive connection rate of 77.6 percent. The Commanders' pass defense, which ranks 20th in points allowed, looks like it could be a liability against a scorching hot quarterback like Burrow. The Bengals' once-struggling defense has suddenly found its footing, boasting the No. 10 ranking for points yielded per game, and is more than a field goal better off than Washington's defense. The search for underdogs in Week 11's parlays is a challenging one, with few options available. However, there are some teams that fit the bill, albeit with varying degrees of promise. The Tampa Bay Buccaneers' chances have improved with the prospect of quarterback Baker Mayfield overcoming his foot injury to take the field. The Bucs come off a bye week, while their opponents, the Detroit Lions, return from a trip to Germany. A significant blow to the Lions' defense has been dealt in the form of pass rusher Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending knee injury. This setback joins ace linebacker Jack Campbell and other defenders on the injured reserve list, hindering an otherwise upgraded unit. The Lions' offense, once considered strong, has struggled lately, making it less demanding for Mayfield to deliver a winning performance. Meanwhile, the New York Jets are another underdog team that can be considered, albeit with some reservations. Quarterback Geno Smith's prospects of starting have improved, but the team's nine-quarter touchdown drought raises concerns. The Jets' middling statistics, 16th on offense and 20th on defense, mask their 2-8 record, while their opponents, the Chargers, have a single victory under their belt. The Chargers' money line of around -170 is notable for a team with such limited success. The San Francisco 49ers have shown they can contain Kirk Cousins when he was quarterbacking another team just two weeks ago. However, now that he's leading a more potent offense, it may be a different story for the Raiders. Minnesota's defense is particularly stingy, allowing only 14 points per game, which ranks among the best in the league. The Sunday night matchup between San Francisco and Minnesota takes place in Mexico City, where historical trends suggest that games can be less predictable than those played on home turf in the United States. articles.title: American Airlines Retires Flagship First International Service
articles.summary: American Airlines has officially retired its Flagship First international service, marking the end of an era for the carrier.
articles.content: American Airlines has officially retired its Flagship First international service, marking the end of an era for the carrier. The decision to retire Flagship First comes after years of speculation about American's plans to revamp its long-haul seating options. The airline is replacing its international-style first-class product with larger and more modern business-class cabins on its marquee planes, featuring next-generation Flagship Suites. These upgraded business-class seats will boast features such as sliding privacy doors and superior technology, which many flyers are likely to welcome as a significant upgrade. However, there's also a sense of nostalgia surrounding the retirement of Flagship First, which was once touted as American's most exclusive cabin option. American's decision to retire its long-haul first-class product is in line with industry trends, where many carriers have opted to sunset their premium first-class offerings in favor of improved business-class seats. These upgraded cabins take up less space and are generally considered more profitable for airlines. American Airlines has been operating its iconic Flagship First class on certain routes for years, but that era is coming to an end. The airline will be retiring this exclusive long-haul seat in favor of more modern and efficient configurations. The decision marks a significant shift for American, which still offers the Polaris Business Class on some flights, as seen on United Airlines' aircraft. However, the Flagship First experience has been a unique offering that sets American apart from its competitors in terms of comfort and luxury. American is currently retrofitting its Boeing 777-300ER fleet to accommodate 70 new Flagship Suites in business-class, replacing the dedicated first-class cabin. This move will not only enhance passenger experience but also optimize seating capacity on these planes. American Airlines has announced that it will stop selling its Flagship First cabin on the A321T configuration after March 28. This decision is likely a result of the airline's transition to its new A321XLR planes, which are being introduced onto top cross-country flights. The retirement of Flagship First marks a positive change for passengers, as it allows them to choose from more lie-flat seats, regardless of whether they're paying cash or using miles. American Airlines' new business-class product is a significant improvement over its previous offering in the Flagship First cabin, with features like extra-spacious seats and bulkhead rows. The airline's decision to upgrade its business-class product also means that passengers will enjoy amenities previously reserved for first-class travelers. This includes perks like more legroom, wider seats, and other comfort-enhancing features. By eliminating the Flagship First option, American Airlines is giving passengers a better choice when it comes to upgrading their travel experience. As part of this transition, American Airlines is introducing its new A321XLR planes onto key routes, which will feature the upgraded business-class product. This move will not only enhance passenger comfort but also optimize seating capacity on these planes. The retirement of Flagship First marks a significant change for American Airlines' premium offerings. Passengers holding Flagship business-class tickets will now have access to exclusive lounges on qualifying routes. This benefit extends to those traveling in Flagship Business and Flagship Business Plus on international, transcontinental, and Hawaii flights. In addition to lounge access, these passengers can also enjoy meal service in the airline's restaurant-style dining rooms located in Dallas, Los Angeles, and Miami. However, this experience is only available on a space-available basis, indicating that availability may be limited. The removal of Flagship First as an official cabin may not have an immediate impact on seating capacity. Despite its demise, some loyal American Airlines customers are expressing mixed emotions about the retirement of Flagship First. For those who have had the opportunity to experience the cabin, it's a bittersweet ending. Some passengers have praised the unique touches that set Flagship First apart from other premium cabins. One industry expert who has flown in Flagship First on multiple occasions notes that while the service may not be drastically different from other business-class offerings, there are still some elevated amenities worth appreciating. The seats themselves will not disappear overnight as American Airlines continues to operate its Boeing 777-300ER fleet with a mix of old and new configurations. The retirement of American Airlines' most exclusive long-haul seat, Flagship First, will be a gradual process that stretches into 2027. Despite this, the airline is already planning to market the former first-class seats on its Boeing 777-300ER fleet as business-class in the future. While passengers who opt for these upgraded business-class seats won't receive full first-class service, they will still enjoy elevated seating. This marks a significant change from the previous configuration, where Flagship First offered unparalleled luxury and exclusivity. As American Airlines continues to modernize its fleet, the legacy of its most premium planes is being redefined, with some now offering more accessible yet still luxurious amenities. The shift reflects the evolving expectations of travelers seeking high-end experiences without the hefty price tag associated with traditional first-class service. articles.title: The Hunger Games Franchise Draws Inspiration from Ancient Greece and Rome
articles.summary: A resurgence in popularity for The Hunger Games has been fueled by recent book releases and an upcoming movie adaptation, which explores the world of Panem.
articles.content: The Hunger Games franchise is experiencing a resurgence in popularity, thanks to the release of two prequel books in recent years and an upcoming movie adaptation hitting theaters on November 20. Author Suzanne Collins' Classical inspirations are becoming increasingly evident as she expands our understanding of the world of Panem. Collins has shared her creative process with audiences multiple times, revealing that she was inspired by a peculiar combination of reality television and war footage while channel surfing one day. This unusual pairing sparked her imagination and led to the creation of The Hunger Games series. Her writing began as an exploration of just war theory, merging the concepts of reality TV and deadly combat. The origins of the Games themselves owe a debt to ancient Greek and Roman traditions. Collins drew inspiration from the myth of Theseus and the Minotaur, as well as the brutal gladiatorial combat that was a staple of Roman entertainment. By combining these elements, she crafted the core plot and style of The Hunger Games. Collins' use of Classical influences is not limited to her creative process but also permeates the world-building of Panem itself. Major Capitol residents are given names that echo ancient Greek and Roman figures, while the terminology used by the people of Panem bears a striking resemblance to historical accounts from these cultures. The connections between The Hunger Games and ancient death battles may be apparent even to non-experts in Classical history. However, upon closer examination, it becomes clear just how deeply embedded these influences are within the franchise. From names to terminology, Collins' use of Greek and Roman history serves as a commentary on the darker aspects of these cultures. This appropriation of historical elements highlights the dangers of authoritarian regimes co-opting cultural heritage for their own purposes. By examining The Hunger Games through this lens, readers can gain a deeper understanding of how power is exercised and maintained in societies that value control above all else. Collins' use of Classical influences extends beyond the names and terminology used within the series. Her depiction of the Capitol as a decadent and oppressive force also draws parallels with ancient Rome's own imperial excesses. This commentary on the dangers of unchecked power serves as a warning to readers about the consequences of allowing authority to go unchallenged. The influence of Greek and Roman history on The Hunger Games is not limited to Collins' creative process or world-building. Her use of Classical terminology and concepts has also been incorporated into the language used by characters within the series, further blurring the lines between fiction and reality. The Hunger Games series has been praised for its thought-provoking commentary on authoritarian regimes, but few fans realize just how deeply rooted in ancient Greek and Roman culture it is. From the names of Capitol residents to the terminology used by Panem's citizens, references to Classical history are scattered throughout the franchise. This blending of fiction and reality has sparked debate among scholars about the implications of such appropriations. One of the most striking examples of Roman influence on The Hunger Games setting is the country itself, which gets its name from the Latin word for bread. Collins has acknowledged that bread plays a significant role in the series, often symbolizing life and sustenance. The Capitol's use of food as a tool to control the population is another example of how ancient cultures are woven into the narrative. By keeping the districts hungry, the Capitol ensures they have no energy left to resist its rule, highlighting the darker aspects of Roman and Greek culture. This theme is perhaps most evident in Peeta Mellark's profession as a baker, where his gift of bread helped keep Katniss alive long enough to spark the rebellion. The significance of bread in both the arena and outside it underscores the Capitol's calculated use of food to maintain its grip on power. The concept of "bread and circuses has been explicitly referenced by Plutarch in Mockingjay, a phrase coined by Roman writer Juvenal in his work Satires. This idea highlights how authoritarian regimes often use entertainment as a distraction from their own brutality and oppression. This borrowing from ancient cultures is not limited to terminology alone; the series also draws on Classical concepts and ideas. The Capitol's manipulation of information and its use of propaganda are just two examples of how Roman and Greek history have been incorporated into the narrative. The Hunger Games franchise has been praised for its thought-provoking commentary, but it also raises important questions about cultural appropriation and the implications of drawing from ancient cultures in modern storytelling. The Capitol's excesses are a stark reminder of the Roman Empire's own decadence, as described by Juvenal in his scathing critiques of Rome's elite. The citizens' gluttony is so extreme that they intentionally induce vomiting to make room for more food. Their reliance on bread and circuses is a deliberate ploy to distract them from the darker aspects of their society, as Juvenal so astutely observed. The parallels between Panem and ancient Rome are striking, particularly in the Capitol's use of entertainment to manipulate its citizens. The annual spectacle of child deaths and Victor celebrations serves as a cruel reminder that even those who have no desire for violence can revel in the power to do so. This insidious dynamic is a hallmark of Juvenal's Rome, where bread and circuses are used to keep the population in a state of complacent apathy. However, this complacency is short-lived, as the Capitol has learned through experience. When the food and entertainment that have lulled its citizens into submission are suddenly taken away, they can quickly turn on their oppressors. This volatile mix of apathy and aggression makes for a potent cocktail, one that the Capitol has carefully calibrated to maintain control. The character Plutarch Heavensbee is a direct nod to the esteemed Greek writer Plutarch, who rose through the ranks to become a prominent Roman citizen and one of the most respected sources for Classical historians. His extensive body of work includes approximately fifty surviving biographies of notable figures from ancient Greece and Rome, published under his influential Parallel Lives series. Despite often incorporating gossip and potentially unreliable information, Plutarch's writings offer invaluable insights into the mindset of 1st century Romans and have shaped public perceptions of these figures for centuries. His contributions to our understanding of this pivotal era in history are undeniable, making him a fitting inspiration for the character of Plutarch Heavensbee. Plutarch's experiences as both a Greek aristocrat and a prominent Roman citizen provide a unique perspective on the cultural and social dynamics at play during this time period. His writings often walked the fine line between fact and fiction, but their enduring influence is undeniable. As a historian and biographer, Plutarch was acutely aware of the power of storytelling to shape public opinion and influence perceptions of historical figures. His own works were carefully crafted to engage his audience and convey the complexities of ancient Greek and Roman society. The parallels between Plutarch's Rome and Panem are clear, particularly in the Capitol's use of entertainment and manipulation to maintain control over its citizens. The character of Plutarch Heavensbee serves as a reminder that even the most seemingly innocuous figures can have a profound impact on our understanding of history and its lessons. Suzanne Collins' father introduced her to the works of Plutarch at a young age, reading passages from his biographies that would later influence The Hunger Games series. Collins has mentioned that Plutarch Heavensbee was given his name because he embodies a sense of historical perspective, one of the few characters in the series who understands the broader context of the events unfolding around him. As a Capitol aristocrat, Heavensbee's education and upbringing would have exposed him to a sophisticated understanding of history, even if he had never known a world without the Hunger Games. His unique position as both a gamemaker and head of propaganda for the rebellion allowed him to shape public opinion and create compelling narratives that resonated with the masses. This is reminiscent of Plutarch's own role in shaping our understanding of ancient Greek and Roman history through his biographies, which continue to be studied today. The concept of the Hunger Games themselves draws on elements from both Greek mythology and Roman politics. One notable example can be found in the myth of Theseus. In this myth, the Cretan king was forced to send seven youths and maidens to Athens every year as a sacrifice to the Minotaur, only for an Athenian prince to volunteer to end the cycle by defeating the monster. The idea of each District providing a boy and girl as Tributes to the Capitol draws inspiration from both ancient Greece and Rome's political systems. This concept is rooted in the myth of Theseus, where a Cretan king forced Athens to send seven young men and women to Crete on a regular basis, only for them to be sent into a labyrinth to be killed by a minotaur. The mythological influence can also be seen in Katniss's character, who serves as a futuristic Theseus according to author Suzanne Collins. Katniss volunteers for certain death to protect innocents, echoing the bravery of the Athenian prince. But what about the word Tribute itself? Its origins lie in Latin, where Tributum referred to a form of taxation collected for military purposes. As Rome's empire expanded, however, citizens were exempt from paying this tax, and it instead became a price that conquered peoples paid as a sign of submission. In The Hunger Games, the Tributes serve as literal taxes paid by the districts after their defeat in the Dark Days, highlighting the brutal nature of the Capitol's rule. This concept is a far cry from the original purpose of taxation, which was meant to fund military campaigns and maintain order within the empire. When Katniss and Peeta arrive at the Capitol, they meet Effie, who warns them that Haymitch is their lifeline to the world - the difference between life and death. This concept of a mentor is ancient and has appeared in countless stories throughout history. However, there's an interesting connection between this idea and Greek mythology that might have influenced its use in The Hunger Games. In many stories, a mentor serves as a guide or advisor, often providing crucial support to the protagonist. Effie's warning also underscores the significance of Haymitch's role as Katniss and Peeta's Mentor, highlighting his importance in their survival within the arena. The concept of a mentor is not new, but its origins are deeply rooted in ancient Greek mythology. In Homer's epic poem The Odyssey, Mentor was a man who advised Telemachus during his father Odysseus' absence from Ithaca. Mentor's role went beyond mere guidance; he also served as an intermediary between the gods and mortals. Athena, disguised as Mentor, played a crucial part in ensuring Odysseus' safe return to Ithaca by advocating for him before the gods and providing his allies with vital information. The word mentor itself has its roots in Ancient Greek, meaning mind" or "thought". However, its usage as a name first appeared in The Odyssey. This raises questions about how The Hunger Games authors might have drawn inspiration from this ancient concept when creating Haymitch's role as Katniss and Peeta's mentor. Haymitch's actions in the arena are indeed pivotal to the survival of the two tributes, much like Athena's support for Odysseus. He provides them with crucial advice, advocates on their behalf to the sponsors, and guides them through the treacherous landscape of the Games. The parallels between Haymitch's role and Athena's in The Odyssey are striking. By drawing from this ancient mythology, the authors may have been intentionally creating a connection between Katniss and Peeta's experiences and those of Odysseus and Telemachus. Ultimately, the influence of Greek mythology on The Hunger Games is a testament to its enduring power to shape storytelling across cultures and centuries. articles.title: Dom Smales Launches New Creator Management Firm WinnieWood Talent
articles.summary: WinnieWood Talent is a new creator management firm launched by Dom Smales that aims to help creators build lasting brands.
articles.content: Dom Smales is launching a new creator management firm called WinnieWood Talent, which aims to help creators build lasting brands rather than focusing on short-term brand deals. WinnieWood will represent talent in the UK and Europe initially, with plans to expand to the US later on. The move marks a return for Smales to the industry after he sold his previous company, Gleam Futures, to advertising giant Dentsu in 2017. Smales founded Gleam Futures sixteen years ago, an innovative idea at the time that involved representing YouTubers like traditional talent. Among the notable creators who worked with Gleam was Zoella (Zoe Sugg), one of YouTube's earliest stars. The firm was eventually sold and its talent management arm formally closed in 2024, but Smales is now back with a new venture. WinnieWood will start by working with UK and European-based creators before expanding to the US market. WinnieWood is open to working with a wide range of creators across various social media platforms, including Substack. The company's focus is not solely on influencers with large follower counts but rather on identifying talented individuals who can drive engagement and generate revenue through their content. Unlike in the past when Smales was managing talent, the creator economy has undergone significant changes and has become increasingly sophisticated. This shift is reflected in the growing number of creators and the substantial investments being made in the market. WinnieWood's business model diverges from traditional talent management companies by offering a more comprehensive approach to supporting its creators' endeavors. In addition to securing brand deals, the firm will also provide financial backing through its investment arm. This injection of capital can aid creators in scaling their businesses and exploring new opportunities. The investment arm is expected to be a significant draw for creators looking to grow their enterprises. Smales notes that he often receives requests from companies seeking to include creators on their company's cap table, indicating a growing interest in partnering with content makers. By offering financial support, WinnieWood can help its clients navigate the complexities of business development. The firm's focus on building intellectual property (IP) with its creators sets it apart from other talent management companies. Rather than simply securing sponsorship deals, WinnieWood aims to collaborate with its clients on developing innovative projects, including shows, art, and other creative endeavors. This shift reflects a broader trend in which creators are increasingly taking ownership of their brands and pursuing new business ventures. articles.summary: The US government has given the green light for six unregulated injectable peptides to be used across the country, including BPC-157 and TB-500, which have sparked controversy in medical circles.
articles.content: The US government has given the green light for six unregulated injectable peptides to be used across the country, including BPC-157 and TB-500, which have sparked controversy in medical circles. This development is not surprising, given the growing interest in peptides among dermatologists and estheticians. Peptides have been a staple in skincare products for decades, with some ingredients like matrixyl gaining popularity as early as the 2000s. Malika Sloan, a medical esthetician based in New York City, notes that the sudden surge in peptide popularity is intriguing, considering these molecules have been around for over 30 years in skincare. She founded Sloan Studio to offer expert advice on skincare products and treatments. Skincare products containing peptides are now more widely available than ever before, with a range of ingredients such as matrixyl helping to drive their adoption in the industry. Peptides have been used in various forms for decades to regulate bodily functions, and their applications continue to expand. One notable example is insulin, a peptide that has helped manage blood sugar levels since the 1920s. In recent years, researchers have discovered the effectiveness of GLP-1 drugs in curbing food cravings and slowing stomach emptying, making them a valuable tool for weight loss. These findings have shed light on the diverse potential uses of peptides beyond their original purposes. From promoting muscle growth to managing inflammation, the list of peptide applications is extensive and varied. Topical peptides used in skincare work similarly to injectable counterparts but focus on localized effects, instructing skin cells to perform specific functions. In skincare, peptides such as matrixyl have been shown to stimulate collagen and elastin production, key factors determining skin quality. This results in a more even-toned complexion, improved barrier function, and reduced appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, according to Dr. Peterson. As it turns out, some skincare enthusiasts are more influential than others when it comes to peptide skincare. Peterson notes that a significant number of young individuals on TikTok are sharing their beauty routines, often without proper understanding or evidence to back up their claims. The reality is that not all peptides have been extensively researched, and until further studies are conducted, the list of effective peptides remains limited. According to Peterson, palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 and GHK-Cu are currently the two peptides with viable data supporting their use in skincare products. Peptides such as palmitoyl pentapeptide-4, also known as matrixyl, have garnered significant attention for their ability to stimulate collagen production and reduce wrinkles. Clinical and anecdotal evidence suggest that these signaling peptides are effective in addressing skin concerns related to aging. The effectiveness of acetyl hexapeptide-8 in addressing skin concerns is questionable. According to Peterson, this peptide's large molecular size makes it impossible for its molecules to penetrate the skin's surface. He likens this peptide to collagen-based skincare products that merely add a component rather than stimulating the body's natural production processes. Collagen is an enormous molecule that cannot be absorbed by the skin, he notes. Sloan recommends combining proven peptides with other validated ingredients in skincare products for optimal results. This approach can be seen in SkinCeuticals' P-TIOX Anti-Wrinkle Peptide Cream, which incorporates ceramides, niacinamide, and moisturizing agents to address hydration and aging concerns. Peterson's alternative choice is The Rich Cream from Augustinus Bader, which pairs signaling peptides with hyaluronic acid and vitamin E to enhance moisture retention and fortify the skin's barrier function. Skincare experts emphasize that peptides can be combined easily with other ingredients due to their generally well-tolerated nature. When incorporating peptide serums into one's routine, Sloan recommends applying them after cleansing and before moisturizing, allowing for optimal absorption and effectiveness. While peptides are a valuable addition to any skincare regimen, they should not be relied upon as the sole solution, as a comprehensive approach including sunscreen use and topical retinoids is still essential. Using peptide serums alone will not suffice in achieving desired results; instead, they serve as a signal to the skin to stimulate its natural repair processes. Peterson stresses that peptides are merely signals sent by the skin's cells, rather than a quick fix or magic solution, underscoring the importance of patience and consistency in skincare routines. Ultimately, peptides should be viewed as just one component of an overall skincare strategy that prioritizes long-term protection and maintenance. articles.title: Biological Aging Can Be Slowed Down by Following Specific Eating Patterns
articles.summary: A study involving 7,500 adults has found a link between following specific eating patterns and slower biological aging. The research used epigenetic clocks to measure chemical marks on DNA.
articles.content: A groundbreaking study by scientists at the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) has shed new light on the link between diet and slowing down aging. The research involved a massive sample of 7,500 adults and found that following specific eating patterns can lead to slower biological aging. To understand this connection, it's essential to grasp what's meant by "slowing down aging. According to Caitlin Hosmer, MS, RD, LDN, a registered dietitian and co-founder of MenoPantry, the study didn't focus on wrinkles or how people feel. Instead, it looked at biological aging using epigenetic clocks. These epigenetic clocks measure chemical marks on our DNA, known as methylation, which change as cells age. The researchers found that following any of 10 healthy eating patterns more closely was associated with slower biological aging. The diets included in the study results are diverse and well-known for their health benefits. The absence of a single miracle food is also worth noting. Mark Gilbert, a nutritionist from The 1:1 Diet by Cambridge Weight Plan, points out that no individual food has been proven to slow aging on its own. This conclusion might seem counterintuitive, but it highlights the importance of a balanced diet in maintaining overall health and well-being. The study's findings suggest that muscle mass and strength are two crucial factors for living a long, healthy life, and these can be improved through diet. However, this raises questions about the optimal approach to slowing down aging. The idea that high-protein diets can lead to faster aging has sparked debate among scientists. Some researchers argue that consuming too much protein can have negative effects on longevity, despite its benefits for muscle and strength. This theory is supported by Hosmer's findings, which show that over 70 percent of biological pathways affected are the same across various diets. Hosmer interprets this data to mean that individual superfoods have a limited impact, and it is the combination of food, diet, and nutrition that affects us on a cellular level. The key takeaway from Hosmer's research is that certain patterns in food consumption are more important than specific ingredients. These patterns include consuming a variety of vegetables and fruits, especially those with deep colors such as leafy greens and berries. Herbs and spices like green tea, ginger, and turmeric have also been found to have beneficial effects when consumed regularly. One particular compound, sulforaphane, has been identified in broccoli and other cruciferous vegetables as a potential contributor to their health benefits. Scientists suspect that sulforaphane's sulfur content may be responsible for its protective effects against cancer and diabetes. While individual foods are important, Hosmer emphasizes the significance of certain diet components in slowing down aging. Protein is a crucial element, but it must be consumed carefully due to anabolic resistance, which affects muscle response with age. As people age, their muscles become less responsive to protein intake, making it essential to maintain a balanced diet. Protein intake is crucial for maintaining muscle strength as we age, according to experts who link muscle power with longevity. However, there's a caveat: excessive protein consumption may have negative effects due to its impact on certain amino acids like methionine. Scientists argue that reducing protein levels in conjunction with calorie restriction can lead to longer lifespans, citing examples from insects and other animals. Some researchers point to the supposed benefits of plant-based diets found in areas known as Blue Zones, where residents allegedly follow low-protein eating habits. Plant foods are rich in fiber, a nutrient essential for gut health that's absent in meat, fish, dairy, and eggs due to undigested enzymes. Fiber plays a crucial role in feeding the gut microbiome, with fermentable fibers serving as a source of nourishment for the cells lining the gut. The importance of a balanced diet cannot be overstated when it comes to maintaining healthy skin and slowing down aging. Research has shown that certain nutrients play a crucial role in this process, including healthy fats such as omega-3s found in fish and the polyphenol-rich fat present in olive oil. In addition to these essential fatty acids, Gilbert emphasizes the significance of vitamin D in immunity and overall health, noting that studies have linked low levels of vitamin D to an increased risk of mortality from various causes. While it is essential to maintain a balanced diet, Gilbert cautions against adhering to any single best" food or diet, as individuals may thrive on different eating patterns. Gilbert also warns about the negative effects of consuming high amounts of sugar and refined carbohydrates, as well as heavily processed meat and regular alcohol consumption on skin health. He notes that incorporating more protein into one's diet can be beneficial in maintaining healthy skin, but emphasizes that every person is unique. While a plant-based diet can be beneficial for overall health, it's not a guarantee against skin issues or premature aging. The problem often lies in poor blood sugar management, which can stem from consuming too many refined carbohydrates and sugary drinks, as well as inadequate protein and healthy fats in one's diet. As Hosmer points out, high blood sugar levels over time produce advanced glycation end products, also known as AGEs, which form when sugar binds to proteins like collagen. This process makes tissues stiffer, affecting not only skin but also blood vessels, and contributes to oxidative stress, a condition that can accelerate aging. Excessive or poorly timed alcohol consumption can disrupt sleep patterns, strain the liver, cause damage to the gut lining, and lead to dehydration of the skin. For women in midlife, it may also exacerbate hot flashes and insomnia. Incorporating more plant-based proteins into one's diet can have numerous benefits for overall health and well-being. According to Hosmer, focusing on this aspect is an excellent place to start when planning meals for healthier skin and slower aging. Learning how to incorporate whole soy foods like tofu, tempeh, and edamame into daily meals can be a great starting point. Adding beans and peas and lentils to dishes in moderation is also recommended. These plant-based proteins offer essential nutrients such as fiber that are not found in animal products. When building meals around vegetables and fruit, it's essential to fill half the plate with these nutrient-rich foods. Opting for deep colors like leafy greens, berries, beets, and cabbage-family vegetables can provide a wealth of benefits. Making grains whole and varied by including staples like oats, rye, barley, brown rice, and whole-wheat bread can also contribute to overall health. Aiming to include 30 different kinds of plant foods in one's diet each week is recommended. This can be achieved by trying new grains such as quinoa, farro, millet, or teff, which are all cooked similarly but offer varying nutritional benefits. By counting plants rather than calories, individuals can create a balanced and healthy meal plan that promotes healthier skin and slower aging. articles.title: Seniors welcome young neighbor into naturally occurring retirement community
articles.summary: A millennial resident of a Washington, DC neighborhood has found friendship and connection among seniors in her building.
articles.content: As a millennial, I've found myself surrounded by a surprisingly large number of seniors in my new neighborhood in Washington, DC. The building where I reside has become a naturally occurring retirement community, with many residents aged 70 and above. It wasn't long before I discovered that my neighbors were eager to connect with me, especially since I was the youngest person on our floor by far. They took it upon themselves to welcome me warmly, leaving behind kind notes and inviting me over for wine. I soon found myself attending various community events in the building, such as knitting sessions, Friday happy hours, and a vegetarian supper club. These gatherings provided a perfect opportunity to meet new people and get involved in my local community. At these events, I met many wonderful individuals who were significantly older than me, some of whom were even grandparents themselves. Despite our age difference, we quickly formed connections over shared interests and hobbies. As the holiday season approached, I found myself feeling isolated from my loved ones who were scattered across the country. Given that some of my neighbors in the building faced mobility issues or distance, it was clear we weren't alone in our struggles to connect with family during this time. A glance at the building's social calendar revealed a notable absence: Friendsgiving, an event I had only heard about but never attended myself. Intrigued by its potential to foster a sense of community among us, I decided to propose hosting one ourselves. Initially, my idea was met with confusion and skepticism by some members of the events committee. They questioned why we wouldn't hold it on Thanksgiving Day, as is traditional in many parts of the country. I explained that Friendsgiving was meant to be a potluck-style gathering where people could come together when they couldn't be with their own families. Despite my efforts to explain the concept, some residents remained uncertain about what it was all about and why we needed it. To clear up any misunderstandings, I had one-on-one conversations with those who were still unclear and also posted explanations in the building's newsletter. Two weeks of discussions later, it was decided that I would host our community's first Friendsgiving in the basement event space, a simple room with card tables, to help bring people together during this difficult time. The Friendsgiving event has evolved significantly over the years, with its initial modest turnout of 12 attendees growing to around 32 by last year. To create a warm and inviting atmosphere, I decorate the room with tablecloths, centerpieces, mini pumpkins, and fall-themed placemats, infusing the space with the spirit of the season. Residents are encouraged to bring their favorite comfort foods or traditional dishes from their families, resulting in a diverse spread that includes desserts like spice cake, Jell-O salad, and chocolate cookies. In addition to the delicious food, we also make sure to include classic Thanksgiving staples such as green-bean casserole, mashed potatoes, and sweet potatoes, satisfying both old and new tastes alike. The event's highlight is the "gratitude tree," where attendees can write down what they're thankful for and display it for others to see, fostering a sense of community and appreciation among those in attendance. Becoming closer to my neighbors has been a significant outcome of hosting an annual Friendsgiving event in my building. This tradition allows me to bridge the age gap between myself and those around 70 years old who live nearby, creating opportunities for meaningful connections that transcend generational differences. The success of Friendsgiving has also enabled me to organize other social gatherings throughout the year, such as a Super Bowl celebration and an Olympics opening-ceremony viewing party, which have further strengthened bonds among our community members. In addition to these events, I've been looking forward to introducing a new element to this year's Friendsgiving: a pre-dinner happy hour that will give attendees some time to mingle before the meal. articles.title: United Airlines and Bank of America restrict use of unauthorized third-party AI agents
articles.summary: Consumers are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools to plan and improve their journeys, with varying levels of risk involved in each type of usage.
articles.content: Travelers are increasingly turning to artificial intelligence (AI) to aid in planning and improving their journeys. Many are using AI-powered tools to explore new destinations, discover hidden gems, and make informed decisions about their travels. For instance, a frequent traveler has found value in employing ChatGPT to devise walking tours in unfamiliar cities. As the capabilities of these tools continue to evolve, concerns have been raised by airlines and banks about how consumers use them. United Airlines recently announced restrictions on unauthorized third-party AI agents, while Bank of America cautioned customers against sharing their banking passwords with AI assistants. This development serves as a reminder that travelers must be aware of the information they share and the actions they allow these tools to take. While this news may prompt some to reconsider using AI for travel planning, it's not necessary to abandon the practice altogether. Instead, travelers should understand the risks associated with different types of AI usage. This involves recognizing the potential pitfalls of asking AI for advice, sharing personal information, and granting authority to make bookings or manage accounts. The various ways consumers are utilizing AI for travel can be broadly categorized into three areas: seeking guidance, sharing data, and authorizing actions. For example, some travelers use AI to research destinations, compare loyalty programs, brainstorm itineraries, and understand the benefits of credit cards. Others upload reservations, statements, or other documents to gain personalized advice. When using AI for travel planning, it's essential to be mindful of the risks involved in each type of usage. As AI agents become increasingly capable, travelers must carefully consider what information they share, what actions they authorize, and when to verify recommendations. By doing so, they can maximize the benefits while minimizing potential pitfalls. Travelers should be aware that different types of AI usage carry unique risks. For instance, asking AI for advice may not pose significant concerns, but sharing personal data or granting authority to make bookings can expose individuals to potential security breaches or unauthorized transactions. As AI continues to transform the travel industry, it's crucial for consumers to understand how these tools work and what they're capable of doing. By being informed about the different ways AI is used in travel planning, travelers can make more informed decisions about their journeys and use these tools effectively without compromising their security or finances. Planning a trip can be overwhelming, especially when considering multiple destinations and activities. However, AI-powered travel tools can provide valuable assistance in this process. Brainstorming destinations based on budget, interests, and travel dates is just one of the many ways AI can help with research and planning. Building itineraries that take into account opening hours, transportation methods, and personal preferences is another key feature of these tools. Travelers can also use AI to discover relevant events during their visit, such as festivals or seasonal activities. For instance, a chatbot might recommend attending the harvest festival in Italy if the user has expressed interest in food and culture. AI-powered travel planning tools can also help with comparing neighborhoods and hotel locations, providing users with a better understanding of the area they will be staying in. Moreover, these tools can offer insights on visa requirements and other necessary documents for international travel. Using AI to plan trips is often relatively low-risk, as users can provide context without sharing unnecessary personal information. This allows travelers to take advantage of the benefits of AI-powered planning while maintaining their privacy. In addition to research and planning, AI can also help maximize points and miles by suggesting ways to stack earnings and recommending the best card for a particular purchase. To get accurate results, users must provide the AI with relevant context, such as the merchant and any specific requirements. AI can also assist with comparing cards when it's time to open a new one, making it easier to choose the most suitable option. Furthermore, these tools can help travelers calculate redemption values, evaluate point transfers, and assess elite status benefits. Travelers can use AI tools without needing access to their accounts, allowing for secure and private planning. To maximize accuracy, it's essential to provide as much information as possible to the AI agent, but even then, it doesn't require account access to perform various tasks such as comparing properties or calculating redemption values. For instance, an AI can compare hotel options at a specific destination without accessing booking accounts, making it ideal for travel research and planning. However, travelers should verify any crucial information provided by AI agents before relying on it for decision-making, especially when it comes to critical aspects of their trip. Double-checking is essential to avoid potential issues such as incorrect driving routes or entry requirements, which can significantly impact the travel experience. Additionally, verifying calculations and redemption rates is crucial, as even minor discrepancies can have a substantial impact on the traveler's budget. It's also worth noting that AI agents may provide overly cautious advice, such as recommending excessively long layovers, so it's essential to fact-check these recommendations as well. It is crucial to verify any information shared with an artificial intelligence (AI) tool that could potentially cause harm or inconvenience if it were incorrect. When interacting with AI, users should be cautious about what personal details they reveal, as this can impact the accuracy and reliability of the advice provided. One important piece of advice is to refrain from sharing passwords, security codes, full credit card numbers, and other sensitive information with AI tools, as doing so can compromise account security. A recent warning from Bank of America advises customers not to share their banking usernames or passwords with AI assistants, emphasizing that customers may be held responsible for any activity resulting from such access. This cautionary approach should also be applied to loyalty accounts, where sharing passwords can put the entire account at risk if the information is exposed or misused. Furthermore, users should be aware that once they share information with an AI tool, they may have limited control over how it's stored or used, depending on the service and their privacy settings. Sharing unnecessary details, such as confirmation numbers, account numbers, and other identifying information, can also compromise account security when uploading documents to AI tools. When using AI for travel, it's essential to be aware of the limitations imposed by airlines and hotels. Some companies explicitly prohibit "automated re-shopping," which means that third-party tools cannot automatically rebook or change existing reservations. For instance, American Airlines has a strict policy against automated re-shopping, while Marriott prohibits unauthorized access to website information without written permission. These restrictions are in place to prevent unauthorized changes to customer accounts and ensure that all interactions with their systems are legitimate. Financial institutions also have rules governing how third-party tools can access customer accounts. Chase, for example, recently updated its digital services agreement to prohibit the use of customers' login credentials by AI agents or other third parties. This move aims to protect account security and prevent unauthorized access. However, not all companies prohibit AI integrations entirely. Some allow customers to connect their accounts to approved third-party services through secure connections that don't require sharing passwords. Before connecting an AI agent to your travel or financial accounts, it's crucial to check whether the company permits the integration. Even if an integration is authorized, you should understand what information the AI tool can access and what actions it can take without your approval. In the travel realm, actions an AI agent might take include booking a nonrefundable hotel stay instead of a refundable one or redeeming miles through the wrong program. When using AI tools to make purchases or change reservations, it's essential to require explicit approval from you each time. This ensures that you're always in control and can verify any changes made to your accounts. Some people prefer to use AI agents to flag potential price drops or award availability for review before making a decision. To ensure responsible AI usage, take the time to understand how each tool collects, stores, and uses your data. This knowledge will help you make informed decisions about which tools to use and how to protect your personal information. When using AI tools for travel planning, it's essential to be aware of the potential risks associated with sharing personal information. This can include uploading documents or connecting third-party accounts, which may reveal more about you than you intend. Some AI services use conversations to train or improve their models, which raises concerns about data protection and privacy. Moreover, even after deleting a conversation, certain AI tools may retain this information, potentially compromising your anonymity. Using an AI tool through another platform, such as WhatsApp, can also lead to multiple companies accessing your personal details. This highlights the importance of reviewing the services you connect to and removing those no longer used. To mitigate these risks, consider opting out of conversation data being used for model training when available. For instance, ChatGPT allows users to limit how their information is utilized, offering temporary chats that don't appear in your history or create memories but may be retained for safety or legal purposes. Ultimately, it's crucial to understand the limitations and risks associated with AI tools before relying on them extensively for travel planning. By being informed about data protection and taking steps to safeguard your personal information, you can harness the benefits of these tools while minimizing potential drawbacks. articles.title: Grand Theft Auto Franchise Celebrates Over Two Decades of Gaming
articles.summary: The release of Grand Theft Auto III marked a turning point in the series' success for many gamers, including the author.
articles.content: The Grand Theft Auto franchise has been a staple in gaming for over two decades, but its early games didn't quite capture my attention as a child. The top-down driving mechanics and visuals of GTA 1 and GTA 2 failed to impress me. It wasn't until the release of the third installment that I became aware of the series' existence. A classmate's PS2 was smuggled onto a school trip, providing an impromptu gaming session in a Wichita Falls hotel room. The Texas Thespian Festival brought students from across the state to perform and compete, with many opting for watered-down adaptations of plays like Into the Woods and Guys & Dolls. As part of our downtime, we took turns playing GTA on a TV set up in the hotel room, huddled around it with five or six others. The game's violent and graphic content was a stark contrast to the wholesome performances we'd just witnessed. We spent hours stealing cars, killing non-player characters with assault rifles, and completing missions that often involved more of the same, theft and violence. The weekend I spent at ThesFest still lingers in my memory, but it's the experience that followed that had a lasting impact on me. It was at this festival that I first encountered Grand Theft Auto III, and I was immediately drawn to its immersive gameplay and graphically impressive visuals. I had played video games before, but nothing could have prepared me for the thrill of GTA 3. It was like stepping into a chaotic simulation of real life, where anything could happen and death lurked around every corner. The game's storyline, which revolved around a nameless protagonist with a chiseled face committing crimes to stay alive, seemed to mirror my own desire for excitement and escape from the monotony of my daily routine. As I navigated through the virtual world of Grand Theft Auto: Vice City, my character's reckless behavior became a liberating escape from the mundane routine of my teenage years. The game's open-world design allowed me to indulge in chaotic driving and shootouts with police officers, while picking up sex workers who would perform lewd acts on my character. This gratuitous violence was a far cry from the wholesome experiences I'd had playing games as a child, like catching virtual monkeys or soaring through serene landscapes. My introduction to console gaming was marked by missed opportunities - having never played iconic titles like Zelda or Mario Kart during their initial release, I dove headfirst into the world of Grand Theft Auto with its over-the-top action and violence. This violent escapism became a defining aspect of my gaming experience. The original PlayStation had been a family-friendly affair, where I'd spend hours playing as a purple dragon or capturing mischievous monkeys in nets. But it was the PS2 that offered me a chance to immerse myself in a world of crime and rebellion - a prospect that both thrilled and unsettled me. As a part-time job at an AMC cinema provided a steady income, I saved up to buy Grand Theft Auto: Vice City with my earnings from selling popcorn and cleaning up spills on the floor. The game was a reward for completing essays or dealing with disgruntled moviegoers who'd lost their patience with Men In Black 2. The soundtrack of Vice City still resonates in my mind, particularly Laura Branigan's "Self Control". The song is forever linked to Tommy Vercetti's iconic motorcycle ride through a palm tree-lined road, bathed in neon lights. My musical tastes were shaped by the game's period playlists, which I listened to repeatedly without realizing their influence. The playlists, carefully curated for the in-game radio, introduced me to a specific era of music that would stay with me long after the game was over. As a freshman in college, I found myself drawn to Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, released two years after Vice City. At 18, I was navigating new surroundings and trying to establish friendships, often using the game as an escape from socializing when I felt overwhelmed. Life away from home gradually became more manageable, and I formed meaningful connections with others. The game's story was eventually completed, but my reliance on it had waned by then. My PS2 was now primarily used for watching borrowed DVDs from Netflix and the school library, a new habit that had developed alongside college life. As I delved into Grand Theft Auto once more, I was struck by how different my relationship with gaming had become since my last encounter with the franchise. Gone were the days of playing it at a low volume; now I cranked up the volume and savored every detail. The games that once provided a respite from teenage angst had evolved into something more sophisticated. I found myself fully immersed in the story, not just the spectacle. The cut scenes no longer felt like an afterthought, but an integral part of the experience. Gaming has become a means to escape the constant distractions of daily life. News alerts and social media notifications can be relentless, making it difficult to focus on anything for more than a few minutes at a time. But in the world of Kingdom Come Deliverance, I could lose myself in the medieval landscape, where every action had consequences. The games' emphasis on realism and patience was a welcome respite from the instant gratification offered by social media. In those simulations, success is hard-won, requiring dedication and perseverance. It's a refreshing change from the dopamine-fueled scroll through feeds that often leaves me feeling empty and unfulfilled. As I replayed Kingdom Come Deliverance and its sequel, I found myself appreciating the craftsmanship that went into creating these immersive worlds. The attention to detail and commitment to realism are traits that set them apart from other games in their genre. The latest installment in the Grand Theft Auto series, GTA 6, has left this gamer feeling an eerie sense of familiarity after several hours of immersion in its dense virtual world. My life outside the game's boundaries is far from perfect, but it's a reality I've grown accustomed to. In contrast, the game presents a starkly different experience that's both captivating and unsettling. The attention to detail and commitment to realism are traits that set them apart from other games in their genre. The franchise has always been geared towards adults, as explicitly stated on its packaging since 2002. Its core objectives remain unchanged: earn a living, accumulate wealth, and survive the harsh realities of the game's world. While this was once a source of entertainment for a teenager looking to escape reality, it now feels alarmingly relatable. As I navigate the game's virtual landscape with a newfound sense of unease, I'm struck by how GTA 6 has made me feel like an old man, struggling to keep pace with the demands of the modern world. articles.title: Iran War Funding Pressures Trump Administration
articles.summary: Democrats are poised to take control of Congress and use their newfound power to pressure the Trump administration to end its involvement in the Iran war.
articles.content: With Democrats poised to take control of both the House and Senate in January, some members are gearing up to use their newfound power to pressure the Trump administration to end its involvement in the Iran war. Democratic Representative Rosa DeLauro is set to chair the influential House Appropriations Committee, which will give her a crucial role in shaping the federal budget. As part of this position, she will have significant influence over must-pass bills that fund government operations. Key lawmakers face a December 11 deadline to secure funding for most federal agencies and avoid a government shutdown, giving Democrats a potential first opportunity to exert pressure on the administration. The war in Iran has been a contentious issue for many Democrats, and some are now looking to capitalize on their potential control of Congress to bring an end to it. In a statement to reporters, Rep. Hakeem Jeffries indicated that he is open to exploring ways to fund the government without continuing resolutions, which could give Democrats leverage over the administration. The party's leaders are currently in "active conversation with each other about how to navigate this situation and ensure that the government remains funded beyond December 11. The Democrats' efforts to end the war in Iran have been gaining momentum, with Rep. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland arguing that the party should use its potential control of Congress to push for an end to the conflict. This could potentially be done through the appropriations process, which is currently being discussed by the House and Senate committees. The possibility of ending the Iran war through legislative action is being explored by some Democrats in Congress. This could involve attaching amendments to any government funding deal that would block war funding until a congressional authorization is obtained. Senators Bennet and Duckworth are among those who plan to offer such amendments. To succeed, Democrats will need to navigate complex procedural hurdles and potentially extend government funding again as well as raise the debt limit in the coming year. They also face the challenge of coordinating their efforts and mustering sufficient political capital to implement any changes. Meanwhile, President Trump has signaled his intention to use his veto power freely. Lawmakers are aware that forcing the president to halt military action will require a delicate alignment of political opportunity, savvy legislating, and coordination among Congress members. Senate Democrats had discussed these issues during a closed-door lunch meeting on Tuesday, as they considered their next steps in this complex process. House Democrats are exploring ways to force more votes on war powers resolutions this year, following several failed attempts to rein in President Trump's actions in Iran. The president did not seek congressional authorization for the military intervention, a move that has been criticized by lawmakers from both parties. Despite some Republican support, particularly from moderate or anti-interventionist members, previous efforts have fallen short due to a lack of consensus. In June, one war powers resolution cleared both chambers, but the Trump administration dismissed it as unconstitutional, arguing that the president has sweeping authority to direct the military. The Senate's recent decision to block another House-passed resolution has sparked renewed discussion among Democrats about their next steps, with some considering whether to push for more votes on similar legislation. It's something that's under discussion right now, said Representative Jeffries, and we'll take a look at vehicles that we have available to us." The path forward for Democrats seeking to end US involvement in the war with Iran remains uncertain, but one option is to send a war powers resolution to President Trump's desk. This move would effectively challenge him to veto it, forcing a public confrontation over the conflict. The war's unpopularity among Americans has created an opening for Democrats to take a stand, and some have suggested using funding bills as leverage in their efforts. A key precedent exists from 1973, when Congress passed legislation blocking government funds for hostilities in Vietnam, Cambodia, and Laos. The effectiveness of such measures is uncertain, with questions surrounding whether the president would heed Congressional restrictions on his authority to wage war. Some analysts suggest that even if a bar were established, there's no guarantee the president would comply, leaving room for continued conflict regardless of Congressional action. The Democratic Party has yet to reveal its strategy for dealing with a potential administration refusal to comply with Congressional efforts to bring an end to the ongoing conflict in Iran. Incoming House Armed Services Committee chairman Rep. Adam Smith of Washington suggests that impeachment should be considered as a means to enforce compliance, but acknowledges that patience is necessary given the uncharted territory ahead. articles.title: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson Returns to WWE Ring for Survivor Series
articles.summary: Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson is returning to the WWE ring for next weekend's Survivor Series in Houston, but his role remains uncertain.
articles.content: The WWE universe was abuzz this week with the announcement that Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson will be making a return to the ring at Survivor Series next weekend. The show is set to take place in Houston, but one question still lingers: what exactly will The Rock do when he steps into the arena? The big money matches are usually reserved for Saudi Arabia's WrestleMania events, which have become notorious for their high-paying deals with top stars. With the 2025 event scheduled to take place in the kingdom, it remains to be seen if this appearance is a one-time thing or the start of something bigger. As The Rock prepares to step back into the world of professional wrestling, five potential scenarios are emerging that could shape his role at Survivor Series and beyond. The Bloodline, a faction closely tied to The Rock, has been making waves in recent months with their intense rivalries and brutal matches. Their upcoming showdown against The 946 in a Wargames match is one of the most highly anticipated bouts on the Survivor Series card. The build-up to WrestleMania 43 is heating up, and Roman Reigns' match against Oba Femi has been touted as a prime opportunity for him to showcase his skills. However, there's still one big question mark hanging over the event: what about The Rock? The people's champion has been a fan favorite for years, and many are eagerly anticipating a showdown with Roman Reigns. This dream match was initially pencilled in for WrestleMania 39, but The Rock's movie commitments got in the way. Then, it was announced for WrestleMania 40, only to be scrapped due to Cody Rhodes' growing popularity among fans. The stage is now set for a potential showdown at WrestleMania 43, with Roman Reigns and Oba Femi's match taking center stage - but could The Rock make an appearance and steal the spotlight? The upcoming Survivor Series event is shaping up to be a star-studded affair, with The Rock and John Cena both scheduled to make appearances. This pairing has a rich history in WWE, with the two having faced off against each other at WrestleMania on multiple occasions. Their past encounters have often been intense and dramatic, but it's also possible that their reunion could be more low-key. After all, given The Rock's status as one of the industry's biggest stars, he may simply choose to cut a promo expressing his gratitude for being part of WWE's 30-year history, and then take his leave. The significance of this milestone is not lost on The Rock, who first debuted in WWE as Rocky Maivia back in 1996. Since then, he has become one of the industry's most iconic figures, with a career spanning over two decades. This occasion could be an opportunity for The Rock to reflect on his achievements and express his appreciation for the platform that WWE has provided him, without feeling the need to create any dramatic tension or conflict. The idea of The Rock joining Team USA and competing in the Survivor Series match against Team Mexico is a tantalizing prospect that could add a thrilling twist to the event. With Cody Rhodes and CM Punk already on board, the dynamics would be electric, especially considering their individual histories with WWE. This scenario would also create an intriguing alternative to the previously rumored match between Roman Reigns and Oba, allowing The Rock to take on one of the existing Team USA members in a high-stakes contest. LA Knight could even be another exciting opponent for The Great One. The outcome of this hypothetical situation is uncertain, but it's undeniable that having The Rock involved would inject an extra layer of excitement into the Survivor Series event, making it an unforgettable experience for fans worldwide. articles.title: Harvard Researchers Develop New Metasurface Design with Intentionally Designed Antireflective Coating
articles.summary: Researchers at Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences have made a significant breakthrough in metasurface design by incorporating an intentionally designed antireflective coating into their devices.
articles.content: Researchers at Harvard John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences have made a significant breakthrough in metasurface design by incorporating an intentionally designed antireflective coating into their devices. This innovation could pave the way for wider adoption of metasurfaces in practical applications. The team, led by Federico Capasso, has been working on metasurfaces for some time, and these ultrathin optical devices are already being used to replace plastic lenses in smartphones. A major advantage of metalens technology is its ability to precisely control light, making it ideal for depth-sensing systems. A key challenge in developing more efficient metasurfaces has been the issue of unwanted reflections. Some of the incoming light is redirected away from its intended path, reducing the device's efficiency. To address this problem, Capasso and his team have engineered a new two-layer design that incorporates nanoscale pillars to minimize reflection. The researchers' solution involves stacking two layers of freestanding nanostructures on top of each other. This bilayer titanium dioxide metasurface is the result of years of work by the Capasso group, who are now refining their technology to make it even more effective. Their latest innovation has been published in Nature Nanotechnology and represents a critical step forward for metasurface development. The potential applications for this technology are vast, from smartphones to medical devices, and could have a significant impact on various industries. The technology developed by researchers has far-reaching potential, but first it needs to overcome a major challenge: unwanted reflections in devices. A metasurface may appear uniform at first glance, but its nanoscale pillars vary in size and shape across the surface, each with its own unique effect on light as it passes through. This variation makes it difficult to apply a conventional thin-film antireflection coating that could improve overall reflection but wouldn't be optimized for every local geometry. Co-first author Davide Cassara explained that the researchers encountered this problem while working on their experiments, and they needed a solution that would provide point-by-point antireflection properties to the entire structure. To address this issue, they created a second titanium dioxide layer co-engineered with the first layer, which provides tailored antireflection capabilities. The upper pillar in the bilayer design is specifically tailored to the geometry beneath it, allowing for local control over reflection. This design freedom enables researchers to explore new possibilities in optical functionalities that aren't possible with a single layer. The second layer not only guards against unwanted reflections but also adds numerous degrees of design flexibility for devices. For instance, differently shaped and oriented layers can produce different polarization responses or directions of reflected light, while additional layers could improve efficiency and support more complex functions such as achromatic lenses. The innovative technology has far-reaching implications for various industries, including augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR), where multilayer metalenses could play a crucial role in advancing these cutting-edge systems. Researchers believe that this method can be adapted to other materials beyond glass, such as silicon, if suitable fabrication processes become widely available. This would enable the creation of optical devices with unique properties, paving the way for new applications in fields like spectroscopy and biological imaging. The research is a testament to the value of long-term collaborations between academia and industry, where experts from both sectors come together to push the boundaries of innovation. By combining materials science and engineering expertise, researchers can create real-world products that have a significant impact on various industries. This project demonstrates the potential for driving advancements in optical lens technology across multiple industries, as Paulo Dainese, senior principal scientist at Corning, noted. His statement highlights the importance of collaboration between industry leaders and academic institutions in shaping the future of technological development. The innovative design of a two-layer flat lens has been successfully demonstrated by researchers using nanoscale pillars to minimize unwanted reflections. This pioneering technology is poised to revolutionize various fields such as optics and photonics, where conventional lenses often suffer from distortion and aberration due to their curved shape. A flat lens that can focus light without any curvature would be a game-changer, one expert notes. The breakthrough achievement represents a significant step forward in the development of more efficient and versatile optical systems.
